# ForgeFlowKit — Free Business Calculators for Solopreneurs & SaaS Founders

> 100 free calculator tools across 15 categories (SaaS metrics, AI cost, valuation, freelance pricing, cost & efficiency, investment, marketing analytics, operations, sales, retention, product analytics, hiring, customer support, knowledge base, legal & compliance). All tools support English and Chinese. Each tool ships with decision-support context: assumptions, what-if scenarios, break-even analysis, common mistakes, and per-tool guidance.

## About

- [ForgeFlowKit Landing](https://forgeflowkit.com/): Main landing page (EN + ZH).
- [About / Methodology](https://forgeflowkit.com/en/about/): Who built this, what we cover, how we maintain accuracy.
- [Contact](https://forgeflowkit.com/en/contact/): Reach the team.
